# device42_cable (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_cable" "myNewCable" {
   cable_id           = "my-cable-001"
   origin_type        = "patch_panel"
   origin_id          = "5"
   end_type           = "netport"
   end_id             = "42"
   cable_length       = 10
   cable_length_units = "ft"
   vendor             = "Panduit"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cable_id` (String) Identifier of the cable. Create only.

### Optional

- `cable_length` (Number) Length of the cable.
- `cable_length_units` (String) Unit of the cable length (e.g. cm, ft, m).
- `end_id` (String) Identifier of the end (destination) endpoint. Create only.
- `end_type` (String) Type of the end (destination) endpoint. Create only.
- `notes` (String) Any additional notes for the cable.
- `origin_id` (String) Identifier of the origin (source) endpoint. Create only.
- `origin_type` (String) Type of the origin (source) endpoint. Create only.
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags to attach to the cable.
- `vendor` (String) Vendor of the cable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
